# 701.52. Roll to Visit Your Attractions (in 701. Keyword Actions)

701.52. Roll to Visit Your Attractions

701.52a To roll to visit your Attractions, roll a six-sided die. Then if you control one or more Attractions with a number lit up that is equal to that result, each of those Attractions has been “visited” and its visit ability triggers. See rule 718, “Attraction Cards,” and rule 702.159, “Visit.”
